derivation_source: Derived independently of current DOM implementation from operator semantics

a_gathering.choreography: Carriers converge centripetally toward active focal plane; velocity decelerates on ingress.

mi_recurrence.choreography: Carriers pulse in periodic resonant orbital loops without advancing linear time.

chu_release.choreography: Filament expands centrifugally, parting from central cluster to signal outbound transmission.

hot_emergence.choreography: Carrier appears from background depth through opacity gradient, strictly contained within bounding viewBox.

col_continuity.choreography: Persistent filament trace bridges preceding state to subsequent state without instantaneous teleportation.

shang_potential.choreography: Upward vertical buoyant drift, indicating pending preparation or unadmitted capability.

xia_return.choreography: Downward settling motion, grounding result back into receiver container.

rest_structural.choreography: Zero-motion state: all carrier velocities dampen to absolute stillness.

near_plane.semantic_role: Immediate interactive focal witnesses (task, active selection)

temporal_law.reduced_motion_override: Instantaneous transform swap; all velocity vectors set to 0.

pedagogue_attack.concern: If all 8 operator glyph choreographies fire simultaneously, user cannot learn which motion represents which consequence.
pedagogue_attack.defense: Choreographies must be sequenced: only one semantic family active per turn (gathering on select, release on send, return on review).

aperture_attack.concern: Far plane opacity 0.20 could be lost under bright ambient glare on mobile, degrading the 39-carrier witness count.
aperture_attack.defense: Acknowledge far plane as ambient depth; do not claim individual far carriers as legal state witnesses in safety receipts.

atlas_attack.concern: Centrifugal release must not visually imply that data departed the device until cryptographic receipt is verified.
atlas_attack.defense: 出 (release) choreography triggers only upon HTTP 200 receipt verification, never speculatively on tap.

fadt_attack.concern: Ambient motion could be mistaken for an interactive action grant, widening the apparent action support.
fadt_attack.defense: Carrier SVG elements remain strictly non-interactive (pointer-events: none); lawful support remains invariant under carrier animation.
